profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Turo
profile.summary: Full-stack Software Engineer in the San Francisco Bay Area working in payments

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built Model Context Protocol (MCP) services to enrich AI agent capabilities with structured enterprise context, supporting more intelligent, role-specific interactions.

Designed and implemented ETL pipelines to normalize and transform incentive (VIK – Value In Kind) data for downstream use in embeddings, powering AI agents that assist account executives in client consultations.

Led development of an agentic onboarding tool that accelerates new engineer ramp-up by offering guided, AI-assisted feature development and workflow orientation.

Partnered with AI-as-a-Service team to develop a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and scalable web service using Python and Langchain, delivering tailored chatbot solutions to clients

Mentored new graduate hires and interns in Spring Boot MVC (backend) and ReactJS (frontend), enhancing their technical skills and readiness to contribute to complex projects
positions.insights: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained internal tools that automated and aggregated application security data, resulting in increased efficiency and productivity across various departments supporting ~3,000+ employees (Value Added Services)

Collaborated with 4 cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and translate them into software requirements

Successfully developed and deployed 26 feature releases to automate 55 tedious processes, reducing manual labor tasks and streamlining operations by 46%

Implemented OAuth2 and ForgeRock-based SSO solutions for multiple applications, enhancing secure access and user authentication

Authored comprehensive wikis for new features and cross-training within our engineering team, enabling faster onboarding of new team members and promoting knowledge sharing avoiding any single point of failure

Retested 38 pentest findings on Visa applications, ensuring compliance with payment industry standards and mitigating potential security risks

Promoted to Senior Software Engineer level for taking leadership roles in projects such as an Open Source Vulnerability Dashboard that earned a Technical Innovation Award within the company

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
● Spearheaded the development of a robust, multi-threaded Python web crawling solution to effectively monitor product inventory for over 100 ecommerce websites
● Demonstrated strong leadership skills by managing and guiding a team of moderators in understanding user requirements and market competition, resulting in ~57% increase in customer satisfaction ratings
● Successfully delivered a scalable Software as a Service (SaaS) solution to a large customer base of monthly paid clients, which generated an average of $10,000 in revenue monthly in its first year of business
● Implemented modular code architecture across multiple projects to improve code reusability and maintainability
